title: LAC Storage Service Engineer
description:
Responsibilities:
Field Technical Support & Troubleshooting
Act as second-level technical support for the FSE Supervisor and FSE Crew within the assigned zone, engaging when a fault or incident exceeds field-level troubleshooting capability.
Diagnose root cause of recurring or complex faults across BESS systems â batteries, PCS/inverters, BMS/EMS, HVAC and balance-of-plant equipment.
Escalate to the OEM/equipment manufacturer when a fault exceeds local resolution capacity, and track the case through to closure.
Support incident response and root-cause analysis jointly with the FSE Supervisor, defining and tracking corrective actions within contractual response times.
Maintenance Planning & Engineering
Develop and maintain the preventive/predictive maintenance plan for assets in the assigned zone, incorporating OEM technical alerts, defect campaigns and field observations fed back by the FSE Supervisor and FSE Crew.
Generate corrective action plans when recurring failure patterns or performance degradation are identified, and track their execution to closure.
Recommend improvements to O&M procedures and to the site Maintenance Scope based on lessons learned from field execution.
Sequence and prioritize inspection and maintenance campaigns across the zone in coordination with the FSE Supervisor, balancing site access, equipment condition and active OEM alerts.
Availability & Performance Management
Monitor plant availability, alarms and degradation indicators across the zone through SCADA/EMS and service management tools, issuing early warnings when trends threaten contractual performance targets.
Prioritize technical interventions according to their impact on availability and contractual criticality (LTSA/SLA commitments).
Support the FSE Supervisor in evaluating spare-parts and resourcing constraints that could affect maintenance timelines or contractual response commitments.
Reporting & Technical Interface
Act as the technical point of contact for client site representatives on engineering matters that exceed the FSE Supervisor's scope of detail.
Document and transfer technical knowledge to the FSE Crew to raise first-line troubleshooting capability.
Feed maintenance plan status, root-cause findings and recurring-failure trends into the Engineering Lead's zone-level and portfolio engineering reporting.
Flag to the Engineering Lead when the assigned zone's site count or technical workload approaches the threshold defined for single-Engineer coverage, to trigger timely evaluation of additional Service Engineer coverage as the portfolio grows.

Requirements:
Requirements

Technical degree or Bachelor's degree in Electrical, Electronic, Electromechanical Engineering or a related discipline.
A minimum of 3â5 years of experience in maintenance or engineering of BESS, solar PV, or other grid-connected/industrial energy assets.

Availability to travel to site as required by the assigned zone.
